feeds.title: Corporette » Lifestyle
feeds.description: A fashion and lifestyle blog for women lawyers, bankers, MBAs, consultants, and otherwise overachieving chicks who want to look professional but still be fashionable. Blog topics covered are fashion, lifestyle, and career advice.

feeds.title: 9to5Chic
feeds.description: I am Anh, wife of an OCD cutie, and mother to a little girl named Lucia.9to5Chic. This is my way of expressing my personal style at work. But it wouldn't be a personal style diary unless I shared some fun weekend outfits when I'm off the clock too.

feeds.title: Memorandum
feeds.description: A New York City fashion and lifestyle blog by Mary Orton offering fashion, workwear, beauty, home decor and travel tips.

feeds.title: The Work Edit by Capitol Hill Style
feeds.description: Capitol Hill Style (CHS) is a fashion blog for women who don't want to sacrifice their sense of style for professional success. CHS features styling tips, product reviews, and professional guidance for fashionable ladies with serious jobs. CHS is dedicated to the belief that women should dress for the job that they want, not the job that they have.

feeds.title: Extra Petite
feeds.description: Extra Petite is a fashion and lifestyle blog by Jean that provides styling ideas and shopping information. This blog also aims to share fashion suggestions and solutions for women who want to look stylish and feel confident at any height or size. Her style is still very office friendly most of the time, while also being very colourful and on-trend.

feeds.title: Julia Berolzheimer » Blog
feeds.description: Covers posts on fashion, daily looks, summer favorites, smocked styles, and more. Julia stands for curated discovery for those driven and inspired by aesthetics. The blog brings together a community of women through its classic, feminine aesthetic.

feeds.title: Blue Collar Red Lipstick
feeds.description: Blue Collar Red Lipstick is a blog by Adina. She mixes casual outfits with retro inspired workwear.

feeds.title: Simply Sacsha
feeds.description: Simplysacsha.com aims to motivate women across all aspects of life featuring workwear style inspiration, advice for work, and most things in between!

feeds.title: The Directrice
feeds.description: A style blog about dressing for professional environments

feeds.title: The Rachel Parcell Blog
feeds.description: We're a creative, fashion, and lifestyle brand founded in 2016. Rachel herself is our CEO and Creative Director -devoted mom, wife, sister, designer, and blogger of all things pink, pretty, and RP-approved. Through her namesake collections, creative content, and personalized brand partnerships, Rachel curates chic and romantic inspiration for your wardrobe, celebrations, travel, home décor, and individual style.

feeds.title: Girl With Curves
feeds.description: Covers everything from trends, style tips, beauty advice, parenting, wellness, self-esteem, body image, motherhood and much more and also solving style and beauty problems. Founded in 2011 by Tanesha Awasthi, Girl With Curves is an award-winning blog made possible by people who believe women deserve to look and feel beautiful, regardless of weight, shape or size.

feeds.title: The Style Sample Blog
feeds.description: I started blogging at the end of 2008, mostly out of boredom. Working in corporate marketing, I thought it was a shame that only my co-workers were seeing my cute outfits every day. The Style Sample is a personal style blogzine full of fashion tips, inspiration and photos for young professional women.

feeds.title: This Time Tomorrow
feeds.description: On This Time Tomorrow , Krystal features daily images of her creative office attire. She loves to mix things up, too, wearing her favourite pieces in unique, innovative ways.

feeds.title: Style Pantry
feeds.description: Style Pantry is your fashion and lifestyle stockist. A network that features interviews on industry folks, street style, lookbooks, campaigns and haute finds. Folake Kuye Huntoon regularly updates her daily looks as a working mother of 3, sharing tips and secrets on where/how to shop bargains and find vintage treasures.

feeds.title: Grey Fox Blog
feeds.description: Grey Fox Blog explores fashion and style for the older and middle-aged man.

feeds.title: Bows & Sequins
feeds.description: Hi there! My name is Jessica Sturdy and I'm a twenty-something currently living in the Gold Coast in Chicago. Bows & Sequins is a fashion-focused lifestyle blog where you'll find posts about my personal style and current sartorial inspirations.

feeds.title: Mama In Heels
feeds.description: Janise has a knack of wearing office appropriate outfits and making them look very soft and feminine. She's quite a classic dresser but always throws in some interesting textures, patterns or colours into the mix. A great blog for everyday office wear inspiration that's easy to emulate.

feeds.title: Political Style
feeds.description: Political Style offers a unique perspective into the fast moving, and ever evolving worlds of fashion, politics and culture.

feeds.title: Sarah's Real Life
feeds.description: Sarah works in law, and she has a very lively sense of style. She definitely rocks trends and mixes prints with gusto, which just shows it's not necessary to let go of your individuality when entering a conservative workplace.

feeds.title: Olsens Anonymous
feeds.description: This is a Fashion blog by fashion addict Olsen.

feeds.title: anna lou elliott
feeds.description: Hi, I am Anna. Welcome to my blog, the home of my ever-changing fashion obsessions. here you will find pieces I love, trends I'm channelling, collections I'm inspired by and outfits I've worn.

feeds.title: Sed Bona
feeds.description: Sed Bona by Ashley is where, She shares her ideas for monochromatic looks and feminine pieces with a lot of skirts and dresses in stunning fabrics and gorgeous colours. Plus, if you want to know how to accessorise your workwear outfits to make them 10 times more stylish, look no further than Ashley's beautiful OOTDs.

feeds.title: Modern Legacy
feeds.description: Modern Legacy is an australian fashion and personal style blog. Here you will find all the latest trends, style, quirky outfits and fashion reviews.

feeds.title: Nine-Thirty to Five
feeds.description: Karen and Paloma both work in law and very frequently post what they wore that day. They blog both casual and more professional looks, and their style is approachable yet very together.

feeds.title: WorkWear-USA
feeds.description: Covers articles abut sustainable workwear, Hi-Vis Clothing, FR clothing, choosing the appropriate PPE for your work environment and more. Workwear-USA LLC is a modern US company dedicated to offer the highest quality workwear available at the best possible prices.

feeds.title: Legal Lee Blonde
feeds.description: LegalLee Blonde is a personal fashion & style blog created by a 20 something Vancouver, Canada based professional. The focus of LegalLee Blonde is style is professional wear for women seeking to remain fashionable and comfortable while at work and at play.
